headline: Chevron and HELLENiQ ENERGY to Conduct Marine Seismic Oil Surveys in Greece
summary: Chevron and HELLENiQ ENERGY will initiate seismic surveys in the southern Ionian Sea off Greece to assess potential offshore oil and natural gas deposits.
why: Chevron is a global US energy firm, while HELLENiQ ENERGY is a major Greek oil refining and utility business.

impacts.name: Chevron
impacts.why: Chevron partnered with HELLENiQ ENERGY to begin offshore seismic exploration in Greece.
